description.value: Oystercatcher is a waterfront seafood and cocktail bar on Salt Spring Island, opened in 2002 and part of the locally-owned Salt Spring Group. Cyclists can dine casually by the river-rock fireplace or on the waterfront deck, with a menu highlighting local seafood, Salt Spring lamb, and regional craft beverages. Its Ganges harbour location makes it a natural stop on a Salt Spring Island cycling loop.

address.value: 110 Purvis Ln #201, Ganges Salt Spring Island, BC
